## Hinge question {#dc2-hinge .dc-lesson}

<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">For <span data-math="x>0"></span>, if <span data-math="y=\ln(5x)"></span>, which expression is <span data-math="\frac{dy}{dx}"></span>?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="\frac1{5x}"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="\frac5x"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="\frac1x"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="5"></span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> <span data-math="\frac1{5x}\times5=\frac1x"></span>. The chain-rule factor cancels the 5 in the denominator.</div>
</div>

::: notes
Additional diagnostic, not a booklet example. Correct choice 3: y'=5/(5x)=1/x for x>0. Choice 1 omits the chain-rule multiplier. Choice 2 incorrectly uses x in the denominator while retaining the inner derivative 5. Choice 4 differentiates only the argument, ignoring the outer logarithm. Equivalent reasoning: ln(5x)=ln5+lnx, with ln5 constant. Default 60 seconds. Fist on chest; think quietly; simultaneous 1–4 fingers on the teacher's “show” cue. Timer expiry must not reveal the answer. Ready: proceed to Example 2.5. Divided: compare the chain-rule calculation with the logarithm-law expansion and revote. Needs explanation: identify outer ln u and inner u=5x; write dy/du=1/u and du/dx=5 before substituting, then retry. About three minutes including discussion.
:::
